Bill.BriefDescription: Offering health benefit subsidies for certain retired public employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offering health benefit subsidies for certainretired public employees; and adding a new section to chapter 41.05RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: From September 1, 2012, through August 31, 2015, the health careauthority shall provide a subsidy of two hundred fifty dollars permonth for health benefit premiums to any member of the teachers'retirement system or the public employees' retirement system who: (1) Is ineligible for medicare; (2) Applies for retirement under chapter 41.32 or 41.40 RCW betweenJune 1, 2012, and August 31, 2012; (3) No later than October 31, 2012, receives the first installmentof a retirement allowance as provided under chapter 41.32 or 41.40 RCW;and (4) Elects to continue participation in a health insurance plan p. 1 SB 6577provided by the board immediately upon retirement.
